# rms_invitation (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS User Invitation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_company" "main" {
  company_name = "My Company"
}

resource "rms_invitation" "new_user" {
  email      = "newuser@example.com"
  role       = "admin"
  company_id = rms_company.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (Number) The company ID to invite the user to.
- `email` (String) The email address to invite.
- `role` (String) The role for the invited user.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the invitation.
